policy: Candidate CC0 sources for external files (textures, HDRIs, models, audio). None is pinned: an item is pinned only by `python3 tools/fetch_assets.py --source <key> --item <id> --pin`, the owner's per-item approval, which downloads into build/asset-cache/ (never into git), verifies the CC0 legal code text against licence_texts, records sha256 and bytes, and appends an entry to the files list of assets/provenance.json. Only CC0-1.0 sources are allowed, at most 12, every one fetch-only. The Poly Haven API host is never used (the checker refuses any mention of it). Choosing which items a game uses is game-repo work. Checked by python3 tools/asset_sources.py --check. Research: docs/research/visual-audio-assets-2026-10.md section 6.5.

fields.key: lower-case label; kit/1 pieces cite an item as cc0:<key>:<item>
fields.name: display name of the source
fields.kinds: what the source offers: texture-set, hdri, model, audio, ui
fields.licence_url: the source's own page stating the licence (human evidence; not hashed, pages change)
fields.licence_text_sha256: sha256 of the licence's legal code text (licence_texts); fetch_assets re-fetches the text and refuses a mismatch
fields.commit: fetch-only: files live in build/asset-cache/, never in git
fields.retrieval: method https-get (host + path with {item}; optional redirect_hosts) or manual (the owner downloads from page and pins with --from-file); item_pattern limits item ids
fields.allowed_types: file types a download may be, checked by content (zip, png, jpg, hdr, exr, ogg, wav, glb)
fields.member_types: file extensions extracted from an archive; other members are skipped and listed
fields.api_terms: API or site terms read during research

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.api_terms: API v2 full_json is documented with no usage terms stated; the fetch uses the direct file URL only
sources.notes: The /get redirect target and the per-map names inside the zip (for example _NormalGL) are UNVERIFIED; add the redirect host to redirect_hosts after the first approved fetch shows it. Normal maps must be the OpenGL variant.

sources.name: Poly Haven (website downloads)
sources.api_terms: The API is never used: its terms forbid use for the purpose of commercial profit and require attribution and a unique User-Agent. The site forbids scraping, so one owner-requested file at a time.
sources.notes: The dl.polyhaven.org path layout is UNVERIFIED: record the item as the path after /file/ph-assets/ of the file URL the website's download button gives. Assets are CC0; the website, logos and renders are not.

sources.name: Kenney
sources.api_terms: none (no API); asset pages state Creative Commons CC0; the Kenney logo is reserved
sources.notes: The direct pack zip URL pattern is UNVERIFIED, so the owner downloads the pack from its asset page and pins it with --from-file; the item is the pack's page slug.

sources.name: Quaternius
sources.api_terms: none (no API); the FAQ states all models are CC0
sources.notes: The download host is UNVERIFIED, so retrieval is manual with --from-file. Run python3 tools/blender/factory.py qa on a model before use; .blend files are opened with scripts disabled.
